card.name: Numbers just before mcg units
card.fires_on: The last digit of a dose number, or the space after it, when the next word is likely mcg (micrograms). Seen in inhaler strengths, aluminum limits and per-kg doses.

modes.label: Final digit of dose
modes.description: A digit, often 0 or 5, ending a number that will be followed by mcg.

modes.label: Space after number
modes.description: The space token between a number and mcg.
modes.example: KABIVEN contains no more than<< >>25 mcg/L of aluminum.

card.writes: It promotes micro and the mu sign, pushing the model to write mcg-type microgram units next.
card.plain: It fires on a dose number when the unit that follows is micrograms.
